## Notes

Introduced in patch 0.7.0.0; Mk.1 (40 x 40 m) unlocks at Tier 4, Mk.2 and Mk.3 added in 1.0; saved blueprints appear in a build-menu tab and draw materials from the designer's storage then the player's inventory.
